title: CarrierDocumentExpiring
description: A carrier's document expires within the warning window; sent once per document. A person paper names `subject_user_id`, a vehicle paper `vehicle_id`; an organization's own names neither.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

expires_at.description: The document's expiry date. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

subject_user_id.description: The person a person paper (passport, driving licence) is about.

vehicle_id.description: The truck a vehicle paper (registration, power of attorney) is about.
